atoms.a: Manchmal tat John Dinge, die er nicht tun wollte, aufgrund des Gruppenzwangs.
atoms.b: Sometimes John did things that he didn't want to because of ((++peer_pressure high_pressure)).

atoms.a: John sollte lernen, nicht nachzugeben, sondern Nein zu sagen. So kann er dem Gruppenzwang besser widerstehen.
atoms.b: John should learn not to ((++give_in resist)), but to say no. This way he can ((++resist give_in)) peer pressure better.

atoms.a: Edanur fühlte sich unter Druck gesetzt, weil sie nicht auffallen wollte.
atoms.b: Edanur ((++felt_pressured felt_alone)) because she didn't want to stand out.

atoms.a: Auch Shane gab dem Gruppenzwang nach, weil er dazugehören wollte.
atoms.b: Shane also gave in to peer pressure because he wanted to ((++fit_in stand_out)).

atoms.a: Stacey gab dem Gruppenzwang nach, weil sie ihre Freunde beeindrucken wollte.
atoms.b: Stacey gave in to peer pressure because she wanted to ((++impress rise_above)) her friends.

instruction.text: Anna berichtet von ihren Erfahrungen mit Gruppenzwang. Lies den Text und beantworte anschließend die Fragen.

hint.sound: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>vice versa</voice> bedeutet andersherum <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>boundary</voice> bedeutet Grenze

atoms.text: A lot of pupils experience peer pressure during their school years. Although it is not always easy, we should try our best to resist peer pressure. In the past, I have given into peer pressure too, and it didn't feel good afterwards. I felt pressured to skip school because all my friends did it and I wanted to fit in. But it wasn't the right decision. I went against the school rules and I disappointed my parents and myself, which I regret. After that, I decided to never skip a lesson again, even if my friends encouraged me to do so. Since then, I do what I want, no matter what my friends say. I don't have to do everything they do and vice versa. If they are good friends, they will respect my decisions and boundaries.

atoms.a: Why does she regret skipping school?

++Because she went against the school rules and her own morals.
